name: 🌯 Dad's Crunchy Burrito Roll-Ups
tagline: Dad's signature: little chicken burritos with a crunchy chip surprise inside, pan-fried golden.

items.name: Bush's black beans, drained and rinsed
Tortilla chips, lightly crushed (the chips are a must)
Taco seasoning (or cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt)
Olive oil, plus more for frying

steps.text: Make the rice by the box. Thaw the corn in a strainer under warm water.
Pat the chicken dry and rub with the seasoning and a little oil. Cook in a skillet over medium-high, 6–7 minutes a side, until 165°F inside. Rest 5 minutes, then shred with two forks.
In a big bowl mix the chicken, rice, beans, corn and half the cheese. Taste for salt.
Warm the tortillas 20 seconds in the microwave so they don't crack. Down the middle of each: a line of cheese, a scoop of filling, then a handful of crushed chips right before rolling.
Fold in the sides and roll up tight. Set seam side down.
Fry seam side down in a thin layer of oil over medium until golden, 2–3 minutes a side. Keep them warm on a sheet pan in a 250°F oven while you finish.
Cut each in half on an angle. Serve with sour cream, mashed avocado and salsa.

kid_jobs.job: Crush the chips in a zip bag (best job in the house)
Mix the filling in the big bowl
Assembly line: cheese, filling, chips, roll
Mash the avocado with a fork and a squeeze of lime

chef_tip: Add the chips at the last second before rolling so they stay crunchy, and start frying seam side down: it seals the roll so nothing falls out.
make_ahead: Cook and shred the chicken and make the rice the day before. Roll right before frying.
leftovers: Re-crisp in a 400°F oven or the air fryer for 8 minutes; microwaving makes them soft.
swaps: Rotisserie chicken in a pinch (Dad prefers the whole breasts)
Pepper jack for a little heat
serve_with: Alexia street corn or a simple salad
heads_up: Rice on first, and oven to 250°F to keep the roll-ups warm.
